liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1990-07-18.sbd.miller.braverman.fix-26352.32218.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 166 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1990-07-18.sbd.miller.95807.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 168 min; rated 4.73/5 by 11 [3]
- **gd1990-07-18.sbd.bertha.28889.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 168 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [6]
- **gd90-07-18.sbd.wilson.12760.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 4.19/5 by 26 [14]. Said about its sound: First set sound quality is unfortunate with fewer sonic details than the second; Feedback in The Other One sounded like rockets blasting off; First set has lots of hiss; second set is tighter but flat with pops [27][28][31]

## Around the show

- Jerry's vocals were particularly strong during the end of Masterpiece [26]
- Reviewer attended the show and describes the experience as profound [27]
- Pure evil laughing occurred during Drums, warning of things getting out of control [28]
- Girls went topless to beat the heat while the band played [34]
- These were the final shows before the band lost Brent eight days later [2]
- Reviewer calls it the finest show played at Deer Creek Music Center [26]
- Reviewer claims this is the best The Other One since the 1970s [32]
- The following day's show on July 19 did not quite match this one [41]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-07-18.sbd.miller.braverman.fix-26352.32218.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master DSet 2: SBD -> Dat -> CD D [1]. Also: File appended from previous etree seed based on Charlie Miller's seed 26352 [1]
- **gd1990-07-18.sbd.miller.95807.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master -> ART DIO (24bit/96k) ->Sound Forge 7 -> CD; Set 2: SBD -> Dat Master (48k) [3]. Also: Set 2 taped with Neumann KM54 microphones to DAT then CD [3]
- **gd1990-07-18.sbd.bertha.28889.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: Set1 SBD>>DAT>>MC>>SHN>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA/SHN; Set2 SBD>>DAT>>CDA>>SHN>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA/SHN [6]. Also: Digitally remastered in 2004 using a custom Dual-DAW system nicknamed Bertha [6]
- **gd90-07-18.sbd.wilson.12760.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [14]. Also: Reviewer found the complete show after losing tapes ten years earlier [29]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1990-07-18 Deer Creek Music Center, Noblesville, IN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1990-07-18-deer-creek-music-center-noblesville-in-usa/) [42]
- Fan art by JamBase: [Grateful Dead ‘Dave’s Picks Volume 40’ Features Deer Creek 1990 Concerts](https://www.jambase.com/article/grateful-dead-daves-picks-volume-40-deer-creek-1990) [43]
